name: decision-guard
description: Stops AI agents from writing their own proposals into your docs as if you had decided them

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Used to check new doc lines with the decision model. Without a key, nothing is checked. Create one at https://openrouter.ai/keys

decision_model.title: Decision model
decision_model.description: Any decision model on OpenRouter, such as typesafe/jev-1.14. Leave empty for the default, perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2. List: https://openrouter.ai/rankings/decisions
